queries_run: Ford Motor U.S. market share 2026 gaining OR losing
Ford new entrant Chinese automakers threat 2026 market share

findings.claim: Ford 10-K 稱產業歷來競爭激烈、產能過剩，業者以折扣與促銷維持市占；EV 政策支持減弱導致該區隔供給過剩，近季已見此類行動重現。
findings.excerpt: manufacturers typically have offered price discounts and other marketing incentives to provide value for customers and maintain market share and production levels, and we saw some of these actions resume as industry production and inventories increased in recent quarters, especially with waning policy support for EVs leading to excess supply in that market segment.

findings.claim: Ford 10-K 風險因子指出其產品面臨汽車及數位軟體服務產業既有業者與新進入者的重大競爭，且新進入者可能加速其重組行動。
findings.excerpt: Our plans for implementing such actions may be accelerated by shifting industry dynamics and new entrants to our industries with which we must compete.

competitive_share_entrants.note: 搜尋摘要顯示 Cox 預估 Ford 2026 前九月美國市占約 12.5%（降近 1 點）、Ford 7月銷量 -9.1%、Farley 7/30 稱中國車廠 5–10 年內可能進美、Ford 將 Almussafes 部分廠區交 Geely；但僅有搜尋摘要未讀頁面，列為 clues。Q2 排名各來源互相不一致。

clues.claim: Cox Automotive 預估 GM 與 Ford 為 2026 年美國市占流失最大的主要車廠；Ford 前九月市占約 12.5%，降近一個百分點。
clues.source: OCBJ / Cox Automotive：Ford US share decline slowing

clues.claim: Ford 2026年7月美國銷量（Ford 品牌）年減 9.1%，年初至今減 9.5%。
Farley 於 2026-07-30 員工會議表示中國車廠可能在 5–10 年內進入美國市場。
clues.source: GM Authority：Ford CEO tells employees Chinese automakers could arrive in the U.S. within 10 years
